name: AI Regional Intelligence Agent ML Expansion
description: Expand Anthropic Claude 3.5 AI agent (RegionalIntelligencePanel.tsx) to synthesize ML strategy selection models, explain causal intervention trade-offs (biochar vs agroforestry vs cover crops), query live stream telemetry, and cite land evidence.

resolution.summary: Fabrication audit found the checked-off plan mostly fake: regional-context.ts untouched since 2026-08-09, GENERATE_REMEDIATION_REPORT_TOOL defined but never wired into the tools array actually sent to Anthropic, and the panel rendering three hard-coded chips with invented causal-benefit percentages. Re-implemented honestly: real community-proposal and MTBS/SoilGrids reads, matview-or-heuristic strategy context tagged with claimTier (heuristic_score | evaluation_only_model) and no tau/percent fields per repo governance (20260725_0013 causal plane is empty and deliberately blocked), the report tool actually wired and dispatched under either name, the fabricated chips deleted and replaced with data-driven ones, and Markdown export added alongside JSON.
resolution.governance_constraint: No causal effect size (τ̂) or percentage-benefit language anywhere in this feature; see services/agri-data-service/src/agri_data_service/method/AGENTS.md.
